W6 after E056. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. Same-commit rebuilds move time by about ±0.05 s and the 3-seed accuracy mean by about ±0.3 pp (E036 read 0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497, 0.7544 and E050 0.7552 for one commit).

Mechanisms and support:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1.5–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near the dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because a frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049, E053). Group 2 shows no cliff by 85% (E053).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure. Losing it is a graded dose: E037 −0.45 pp, E054 −0.35, E055 about −0.15.
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead-interval, BN-recalibration and batch-split tweaks are null or negative. The recipe is near a local optimum. wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp (E016).
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more accuracy than it saves in time. E056 (ReLU, which I forecast at no gain) measured 4.95 s, about 0.25 s below the tip. I treated it as a profiling-only run, but the time saving looks real. Elementwise bytes are therefore a bigger lever than I assumed, though ReLU's accuracy is unproven.
7. Build noise and seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The tip's population mean is about 0.752–0.754, so the bar is barely cleared.
8. Time misses all went the same way: my time forecasts have been too high for the freeze/trim/ReLU runs by 0.1–0.2 s. Widen the low side of time ranges.

Unsure: the true rebuild SD, whether coarse labels are shipped and allowed, PCIe transfer, and whether the 3-seed gate can ever pass a faster recipe.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic. I expect a build SD of about 0.08–0.12 pp and a fresh-seed mean a bit below 0.7539 because of winner's curse.
E052 and E053 have a fresh population mean near 0.752. With σ_tot around 0.15 pp the gate needs μ̂ ≥ 0.7525, so it is a coin flip.
E046 is E049 minus 0.25 epoch. I expect a dial of about 1–2 s/pp, with noise larger than the effect.
The standard torchvision CIFAR-100 pickle does include coarse labels, but the benchmark loader exposes only fine labels, so this is likely blocked. If it runs, the gain is small.
The port code sets BN weight.requires_grad=False in BatchNorm.__init__, so this closes by code read with no run. If it did run, the result would be neutral.
The saving is about 0.5%, below build noise, and the accuracy change is likely within ±0.1 pp.
Offline diagnostic. Update-rate curves will decay with the LR schedule, so they will only partly separate the known outcomes.

cruxes: Did E056's 0.25 s time drop come from ReLU-like elementwise savings that would carry over to an actual ReLU swap, and what is its accuracy cost?
What is the true rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean (I088)? It decides whether any candidate under 0.15 pp can be kept.
Does the benchmark loader expose CIFAR-100 coarse labels, and do the rules allow using them?
